messages:
Alex S: Vanguard Health just uploaded an RFI + capability matrix. they want a 4-week POC, pricing tiers, and answers to a 120-question security questionnaire. attaching sheet: <https://drive.redwood.com/attachments/vanguard_rfi_v1.xlsx|vanguard_rfi_v1.xlsx>
Priya (SE): On it. can we confirm the POC scope? they said 'chat + summaries + embedding search' and want data residency in eu-west-1.
Marcos (Eng): EU region OK. for embeddings we should recommend dedicated pool for throughput. question: do they need HSM-backed keys or just KMS?
Talia (Security): Security Q highlights: encryption at rest, HSM/KMS, audit logs retention, SOC2 docs, pen test report. I'll draft answers but need the customer's compliance contact.
Sam (Pricing): For a 4-week POC with reserved capacity estimate: small POC (2 v100 equiv) = $9k/mo pro-rated, dedicated burst = +$2k. I'll put a quick rate card. any expected tokens/day?
Alex S: They quoted 10M tokens/day peak, avg 2M/day. also asked about model fallbacks and quantization options.
Priya (SE): Notes: recommend model variants: redwood-llama-70b-quant and redwood-llama-13b for fallback. batching config: 64 seq batch for embeddings.
Marcos (Eng): Quick config snippet for POC nodes:
```
pool: dedicated-eu-2
instance_type: gpus.1xA100
autoscale:
  min: 1
  target_qps: 120
  burst: 2
```
Use prefix caching for chat sessions.
Talia (Security): For HSM: we support BYOE-HSM on Private deployment. For Hosted we can integrate customer KMS (AES-GCM keys) + audit streaming to their S3. I'll attach SOC2 link.
rfi-bot: Vanguard RFI file uploaded: vanguard_rfi_v1.xlsx (size: 420KB)
Sam (Pricing): Draft pricing note: - Hosted API usage: $0.0012/token gen, $0.0008/token context; - Dedicated POC commit (monthly pro-rated): $9k; - Optional private deployment one-time: $120k + support. I'll attach spreadsheet.
Jess (Legal): Are there any unusual contract asks in the RFI? I saw a data escrow and indemnity clause flagged. please forward the specific sections.
Alex S: forwarded sections 8.2 and 12.1 in the sheet. also they want SLA for latency below 200ms for chat.
Marcos (Eng): 200ms SLO is tight for 70b in eu with our current instance types; we can aim for 250ms median if we use A100x2 + quantization. recommend including automatic fallback to smaller model to preserve latency.
Priya (SE): POC checklist I'm going to add to the sheet: environment access, sample dataset (anonymized), SSO config (SAML), KMS ARN, contact for compliance. I'll ping them for dataset NDA.
Talia (Security): I'll prepare security questionnaire answers. tagging @Priya to add a pointer for how we handle logs retention for EU customers (we keep audit logs 90 days by default, can extend).
Sam (Pricing): One more: confirm if they need per-seat pricing for support or just standard support included? could affect PoC bump.
Alex S: They want 24/7 support for the PoC window. Sam, factor that in.
Priya (SE): Action items: 1) Priya to update sheet with POC checklist (ETA 3h). 2) Talia to draft security answers (ETA EOD). 3) Sam to produce pro-rated ratecard (ETA 2h). 4) Marcos to propose SLOs & infra config (ETA 6h). 5) Jess to review contract asks (ETA EOD).
Marcos (Eng): I'll also include a quick perf test plan and suggested synthetic load command for them:
```
# run perf generator
./perf-gen --qps 120 --seq-len 512 --model redwood-llama-13b
```
Priya (SE): I'll reach out to the Vanguard contact (elena.v@vanguardhealth.com) for dataset and SSO details.
Alex S: Thanks team. I'll prepare a short executive summary for their CTO and schedule an internal sync at 4pm PST. :thumbsup:
Talia (Security): FYI we should confirm their data retention policy for PHI; if PHI is in scope we may need Private deployment. tagging legal.
Jess (Legal): noted. will check escrow/indemnity flags and advise.
Alex S: Closing note: Let's aim to send a consolidated RFI response + capability matrix + PO C checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (SE): ack.
Sam (Pricing): ack.
Marcos (Eng): ack.
Talia (Security): ack.
Jess (Legal): ack.
